class MemSMT:
    """Binary sparse Merkle tree, 256-bit keys, compressed proofs."""
    def __init__(self):
        self.leaves = {}              # key(32B) -> value_hash(32B)
        self.nodes = {}               # (depth, prefix_bits:int) -> hash(32B)

    def _bit(self, key: bytes, d: int) -> int:
        return (key[d >> 3] >> (7 - (d & 7))) & 1

    def _pref(self, key: bytes, d: int) -> int:
        # first d bits of key as int
        v = int.from_bytes(key, "big")
        return v >> (256 - d) if d else 0

    def put(self, key: bytes, value: bytes):
        vh = _h(b"\x04v", value)
        self.leaves[key] = vh
        for d in range(257):
            p = self._pref(key, d)
            self.nodes.pop((d, p), None)      # invalidate ancestors' cached hashes

    def _subtree(self, d: int, pref: int) -> bytes | None:
        """Hash of subtree rooted at (d,pref); None if empty. Memoized."""
        if (d, pref) in self.nodes:
            return self.nodes[(d, pref)]
        if d == 256:
            k = pref.to_bytes(32, "big")
            vh = self.leaves.get(k)
            h = leaf_hash(k, vh) if vh else None
            if h: self.nodes[(d, pref)] = h
            return h
        lh = self._subtree(d + 1, pref << 1)
        rh = self._subtree(d + 1, (pref << 1) | 1)
        if lh is None and rh is None:
            return None
        h = _h(P_NODE, lh or EMPTY[255 - d], rh or EMPTY[255 - d])

        t = lcp(qk, fk)
        if t == 256 or bit(qk,t) == bit(fk,t): return INVALID("E_TERM")
        walk = fk; leaf = H(P_LEAF, fk, fvh)
